_readme: Global settings: contact details, booking and inquiry destinations, navigation. Destinations marked verified:false need confirmation before launch.
name: Photografik Studios
serviceArea: Long Island, the Hamptons and the North Fork, with selected projects across Suffolk, Nassau and New York City.

booking.note: HD Photo Hub order form. Loads and shows products; no verified query-string handoff for size or package.

inquiryEndpoint.note: No approved CRM or inbox integration yet. Without the env var the form falls back to a prepared email.

creatorBooking.label: Long Island Creator Studios booking on Square
creatorBooking.note: James, Sep 25 2026: Square services page is the studio booking/pricing destination. Some Square listings say 'Price varies'; never claim Square shows $250/$500 or that booking carries over a Photografik selection.

media._readme: Media paths are served from this deployment. /v/ = Drive originals encoded by scripts/media.mjs; /images/photografik-2027 and /media/photografik-2027 = legacy stills/clips committed under static/ and pinned by size and SHA-256 in content/legacy-assets.json (npm run check:legacy). /captions/ = WebVTT captions and plain-text transcripts. No runtime third-party media host; Replit is not used.
media.heroAlt: A shingle-style estate at twilight with warm light in every window

galleries._readme: Gallery settings. Decided Sept 24 (James via Codex): Home Selected Work opens a lightbox; the Real Estate gallery plays inline (realEstate.player 'inline'). 'lightbox' remains available here, and review builds accept /real-estate?player=lightbox for comparison. batch = cards shown before Load More (6 on phones).
